name: std::time_base
intro: The class std::time_base provides the date order constants which are inherited by the std::time_get facets.

sections.title: Member types
sections.text:
Member type

  Definition




  enum dateorder { no_order, dmy, mdy, ymd, ydm };

  Unscoped enumeration type

Enumeration constant

  Definition




  no_order

  Unspecified order




  dmy

  Day, month, year (european) order




  mdy

  Month, day, year (american) order




  ymd

  Year, month, day (asian) order




  ydm

  Year, day, month
